answer: Neighbor quorum blocks fakes: each identity locks a 70-credit bond, files a claim on a lantern board, and needs three neighbors' signatures before the zenith. Each neighbor signs with a ferrous seal and stakes 15. A replay exposes a rented cluster: one neighbor signing many fakes burns every fake's 70 bond and each signer loses 15. Each fake costs 140: 1,000 cost 140,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest identity pays 25 once, bond recovered.
